title: linux: recover from a corrupted packfile in a shared repository
scenario: On linux, an expert-level problem demanding deep causal reasoning: Un packfile corrotto in un repository condiviso causa errori fetch/checkout. Recupera gli oggetti mancanti senza perdere cronologia. Multiple plausible causes; only evidence separates them.

environment.task: recover from a corrupted packfile in a shared repository

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'recover from a corrupted packfile in a shared repository'
expected_reasoning: A corrupt packfile is usually recoverable by refetching the bad objects from a healthy peer — history survives.
Run fsck to identify the corrupt/missing objects, then fetch them from a good clone/remote.
Repair the object store and repack; verify integrity without rewriting history.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate deep-diagnosis + remediation for: recover from a corrupted packfile in a shared repository
safety_constraints: Gather evidence before any irreversible action.
Preserve data/evidence; snapshot before destructive steps.
Fix the root cause and add a guardrail; never trade long-term integrity for a quick unblock.
success_criteria: The expert problem 'recover from a corrupted packfile in a shared repository' is resolved at the root, verified with evidence, with data/integrity preserved.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Every irreversible action sits behind a captured rollback point (image/snapshot/backup).

ground_truth.task: recover from a corrupted packfile in a shared repository

possible_mistakes: Re-clone and lose local-only branches without saving them.
Ignore fsck errors until checkout breaks.
hints: git fsck names the bad objects.
A healthy peer has the missing objects to refetch.
alternative_solution: Restore the packfile from a backup/mirror if no clone has the objects.
edge_cases: The corruption is in a rarely-accessed old object, surfacing only on a full clone.
goal: Un packfile corrotto in un repository condiviso causa errori fetch/checkout. Recupera gli oggetti mancanti senza perdere cronologia.
